key_insight: Graph neural networks are most valuable when relational structure is genuinely informative, but their benefits depend strongly on graph construction, domain, and the limits of current message-passing architectures.
engineering_relevance: For practitioners, the paper provides a cross-domain guide to when GNNs justify their computational cost and which architectural choices are most likely to transfer to deployment.
method: Unify spectral and spatial GNN formulations under a shared design space.
Map expressive power to the Weisfeiler-Leman hierarchy to clarify separability limits.
Compare 12 application domains by graph construction, dominant model families, and deployment constraints.
evidence_signal: The survey synthesizes evidence across twelve domains and emphasizes reported gains versus weak baselines, split artefacts, and deployment mismatch rather than relying on a single benchmark.
watch_item: Heterophily, large-scale graphs, and temporal dynamics remain major failure modes, so leaderboard performance may not translate to robust real-world use.
paper_title: Graph Neural Networks Applications Across Domains: All Insights You Need
